eyebrow.zh: 签名 · 权限漂移 · CI 门

headline.zh:
Skill 权限悄悄变大
之前先在 CI 拦住
headline.en:
Stop a skill's scope
creeping, in CI

sub.zh: skillsig 给 Claude Code Skill 声明范围的 YAML manifest，加 Sigstore keyless 签名，再用锁文件做跨版本权限漂移检测 —— 权限扩张就让 CI 非零退出。
sub.en: skillsig gives a Claude Code skill a scope-declaring YAML manifest, Sigstore keyless signing, and lock-file cross-version drift detection — any scope expansion exits CI non-zero.

body.zh: 每个 Skill 写一份 SKILLSIG.yaml manifest，声明四个轴的意图范围：model · tools · fs_write · network_egress；scope 引擎把它和 SKILL.md 里实际生效的 allowed-tools 做 diff。
body.en: Each skill gets a SKILLSIG.yaml manifest declaring intended scope across four axes — model, tools, fs_write, network_egress — and the scope engine diffs it against the allowed-tools actually in effect in SKILL.md.

body.zh: scope 引擎把声明白名单和实际授权做 diff（带 Tool(prefix*) 通配语义），再和 ~/.skillsig/lock.yaml 基线比对 —— 某个 Skill 0.3.0 之后悄悄多加一行 Bash(rm -rf …) 就会被 SCOPE-DRIFTED 标出来。
body.en: The scope engine diffs the declared whitelist against the actual grants (with Tool(prefix*) wildcard semantics), then against the ~/.skillsig/lock.yaml baseline — a skill that quietly adds Bash(rm -rf …) after 0.3.0 is flagged SCOPE-DRIFTED.

body.zh: verifier 校验 ed25519 或 Sigstore keyless 签名 bundle —— 上周审过的那份 manifest，是不是就是刚拉下来的那份，签名说了算。
body.en: The verifier checks an ed25519 or Sigstore keyless signature bundle — whether the manifest you reviewed last week is the one just pulled down is answered by the signature.

title.zh: 三色判定 · 离线 CI

body.zh: 全程本地、不联网，最终一张 TRUSTED / UNSIGNED / SCOPE-DRIFTED 三色表；带 --ci 时一旦范围扩张就返回非零退出码，让 CI 直接 fail。
body.en: Fully local, no network, ending in a TRUSTED / UNSIGNED / SCOPE-DRIFTED table; with --ci any scope expansion returns a non-zero exit code so CI fails outright.

headline.zh: 给你的 Skill 签个名

sub.zh: MIT 许可，go install 即用；skillsig init 生成 manifest，sign 签名，verify 卡住漂移。
sub.en: MIT-licensed, go install and run; skillsig init writes a manifest, sign signs it, verify catches the drift.
